text:
sara_sales: Hey team — quick sync for AcmeHealth POC. They need a short timeline (3 weeks), sample-data access pattern, and success criteria. Asking: can we accept masked PHI CSVs in S3, or do they need VPC peering?
eng_sean: Short answer: both are possible. Preference: VPC peering for lowest blast radius & direct control. S3 + presigned uploads is fastest to stand up.
solutions_ryan: For success criteria propose: 1) end-to-end demo with 95th percentile latency < 300ms for prompt length ~512 tokens, 2) retrieval accuracy > 85% on our eval set, 3) cost per 1k tokens under $X (TBD). Also need a prompt/eval harness.
amanda_cust: Can confirm Acme can provide de-identified CSVs (name/email removed) but rows contain treatment codes and free-text notes. They prefer not to open a peered VPC in week 1.
security_julia: Important: "de-identified" doesn't always satisfy our policy. We need redaction rules and a security questionnaire + SOC2 addendum signed. If they insist on CSV uploads, we require client-side redaction or a signed DPA.
eng_sean: Agreed. Minimal POC plan: Week 0: creds + upload path; Week 1: ingestion + redaction validation; Week 2: prompt/eval runs and perf tuning; Week 3: final demo + handoff.
eng_sean: Technical details for CSV ingestion (share with them):
```bash
# example presigned upload flow
# 1) POST to our API to request presigned URL
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/presign -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"file_name":"acme_deid.csv","bucket":"acme-poc"}'
# 2) PUT the file to the link
curl -X PUT "<presigned-url>" -T acme_deid.csv
```
security_julia: Also provide a recommended redaction regex and sample transform we will verify on ingest. Example (very conservative):
```regex
/(?i)(?:\b(ssn|social\s*security|mrn|mrn:)\b|\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b)/
```
eng_sean: We'll run a verification job that emits a small audit log with counts (no PII in logs). We can optionally run a heuristics-based scrub and return a remediation report for them to fix at source.
infra_ops_bot: @sara_sales Sandbox infra checklist:
- Create temporary S3 bucket (acme-poc-<rand>)
- Generate short-lived credentials (24h by default)
- Enable request logging to audit-bucket
- Optionally enable VPC endpoint for S3 if they want no public egress
deploy-bot: Sandbox provisioned: bucket acme-poc-8421 created, temporary role acme-poc-role-202603 created (credentials expire in 72h).
sara_sales: Thanks — can we get pricing for a 3-week POC (expected ~100k tokens/day peak)? Need estimate to share with the customer.
solutions_ryan: I'll draft a POC quote: hosted usage + 4 dedicated concurrent slots for burst testing + 1 engineer SOW for setup & security review. Putting numbers together and will post by EOD.
amanda_cust: Timeline constraints: clinical team wants results before the month-end board meeting. If we can avoid VPC peering and accept masked CSVs, they can deliver data by Monday.
security_julia: If they deliver masked CSVs, we still need: 1) sample of 50 rows for redaction validation, 2) signed DPA + minimal questionnaire answers (we can share a short subset).
eng_sean: For evals, Ryan — can you define 20-30 ground-truth prompts (free-text QA + retrieval rerank) and an automated scoring script? We'll run perf + quality in Week 2.
solutions_ryan: Yup. I'll prepare prompts and an eval harness (pytest-style) that outputs accuracy, F1, and latency histograms. Will attach sample prompts to the POC playbook.
security_julia: One blocker I foresee: customer legal wants KMS in their cloud for key control. For hosted POC we can support envelope encryption but not customer-managed KMS unless Private deployment. Flagging to sales.
sara_sales: Noted — will surface to customer. If KMS is a hard requirement, escalate to AE for Private/Dedicated discussion.
eng_sean: Also note: to hit 300ms 95p we might need quantized model variant and batching disabled for low concurrency. We'll test two model flavors and pick fallback rules.
amanda_cust: Slight preference for lower cost over absolute latency, board will accept 400ms if cost is 20% lower.
solutions_ryan: Add to success criteria: alternate threshold for cost-first tradeoff.
sara_sales: Action items:
- Ryan: prompts + eval harness + POC quote (by EOD)
- Sean: ingestion runbook + presign example + redaction verification job (tomorrow)
- Julia: minimal SQ subset + DPA checklist (tomorrow)
- Infra: confirm creds expiry policy and audit log retention (72h/30d?)
- Amanda: share 50-row sample and confirm delivery date

eng_sean: Quick note on logs: we store only aggregate counts and a single hash of each filename for traceability. No row-level content persists after scrub.
security_julia: Confirmed — still need to review their SOC attestation.
deploy-bot: Reminder: acme-poc-8421 role rotated, new creds pushed to the secure channel.
sara_sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and post the short POC playbook after Ryan's prompts arrive. :thumbsup:
